header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): tools/play_plan.json's play with two stand-in pads of one model plugged in at the launcher, before Start
Game, as a player's pads are there when the game starts. Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were
plugged in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER), with no players assigned: the game counts two controllers as it starts them
(an s16 at 0x800FD868, which the function that calls osContInit, func_80016840, counts), so it offers a player for
each, and pad 2's A is port 2's alone (the buttons held a port, u16s at 0x800F8700 that function clears: port 2's
0x800F8702). Its rumble reaches pad 1 on the way to the board (padRumbles(): plays per pad, in the order they were
plugged in): src/main/main.cpp's Rumble Pak in each port with a controller.
start: plugPads(["Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)","Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)"])
